extracted_concepts.name: Greatest Common Factor
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The largest positive integer that divides two or more numbers without a remainder.

extracted_concepts.name: Least Common Multiple
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The smallest positive integer divisible by two or more given numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Equivalent Expressions

extracted_concepts.name: Rectangular Prism Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Calculating volume of right rectangular prisms, including those with fractional edge lengths.

extracted_concepts.name: 3D Nets
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Representing three-dimensional figures using two-dimensional unfolded layouts.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistical Question
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A question that anticipates variability in data and can be answered by collecting data.

extracted_concepts.name: Data Distribution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Summarizing and describing how data values are spread or clustered.

extracted_concepts.name: Measures of Center
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Statistics like mean and median that describe the central tendency of a dataset.

extracted_concepts.name: Measures of Variation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Statistics like range and interquartile range that describe data spread.
